name: Ahes
text: Ahes stands as a Breton goddess who raised the Roman roads in Brittany. The Welsh Elen also watches over roads, and some writers connect the two. Keep this Ahes apart from Ahès, a second name for the selfish Dahut. Ahes rules as the patron of road building.

attributes.attribute: a Breton goddess who built the Roman roads
linked with the Welsh Elen as a patroness of roads

okr.objective: Profile Ahes as the Breton goddess of Roman road building.
key_results: Credit Ahes with building the Roman roads in Brittany.
Link Ahes with the Welsh road patroness Elen.
Distinguish this goddess from Ahès, the name of Dahut.
